description.value: At MRI-1 and MRI-2, alcoholic men were scanned after periods of sobriety; healthy control subjects were scanned at a comparable interval. At MRI-3, a subset of controls and alcoholics were rescanned, with alcoholic participants classified as abstainers or relapsers according to subsequent drinking status.

spans.text: We obtained magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) on 58 alcoholic men after an average of 12 days (MRI-1) and 32 days (MRI-2) of sobriety. In addition, 58 healthy control subjects were scanned at a comparable interval. At MRI-3, 11 controls and 39 alcoholics were rescanned, 2–12 months after MRI-2; 19 alcoholics had abstained, and 20 had resumed drinking.
